title: 2019 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.topic: 中国成语的特点、来源与使用价值
analysis.reference: Chinese idioms are a unique form of expression in the Chinese language, most of which consist of four Chinese characters. They are highly concise and fixed in form, yet usually can vividly convey profound meanings. The majority of Chinese idioms originate from ancient Chinese literary works, and are usually associated with certain myths, legends, or historical events. If one does not know the origin of a particular idiom, it will be difficult to understand its exact meaning. Therefore, learning idioms helps people gain a better understanding of traditional Chinese culture. Idioms are widely used in daily conversations and literary creation. The appropriate use of idioms can make one's language more expressive and communication more effective.

pitfalls: 「大多由四个汉字组成」易误译为 most of them are made up by four...，应注意 consist of 无被动形式
「形象地表达」的 vividly 常被遗漏，或误用 lively（形容词）替代副词
「出处」origin 易误写为 resource 或 source，后者虽可接受但 origin 更贴切
原文「因为」实为「因此」（therefore），若译成 because 则逻辑不通，需根据上下文判断
「更具表现力」应译为 more expressive，易误译为 more expression（词性错误）
